column1: # MiniSpeedCam r1.1 ESP32-S3 (8 MB flash) -- dual-app OTA layout.
# Two app slots are required for over-the-air updates: the device downloads the
# new image into the INACTIVE slot and flips to it on reboot (power-fail-safe
# with bootloader rollback if it doesn't boot clean). NVS keeps the standard
# 0x9000 offset so stored WiFi creds + settings survive migrating onto this
# table; the coredump partition preserves esp_core_dump to-flash crash

column2: so each 2.81 MB slot has headroom.
